blocker_responses.blocker: Budget fail-closed is incomplete for negative budgetRequest.maxCostUsd.

Added a regression test that expected_output=PlanDraft with output_contract=None raises AgentOutputContractError instead of accepting raw {'kind':'PlanDraft'}.
